Subject: RE: Discovery call — security qualification (FirstBank)

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key things we heard from your security and procurement teams and outline a practical evidence path so we can keep the review moving without surprises.

Summary of pain points and goals (from your side):
- Audit log retention and exportability: you need immutable, tamper-evident logs retained for 7 years with easy export for auditors.
- SOC 2 scope: you want to confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 coverage and map which controls cover ingestion, storage, and access of customer data.
- DPA redlines: procurement will require DPA changes around data deletion and subprocessor disclosure.
- Pen test/architecture review: security wants options to provide a pen test report or a review engagement.

What Redwood can provide (next steps we agreed):
1) SOC 2 evidence packet — we will share the most recent report and a control-mapping summary for the features you care about (logs, access controls, key management).
2) Audit-log sample export — small sample with metadata and integrity checks (anonymized) so you can validate retention/export workflow.
3) DPA redline — we will send a proposed DPA with our standard carve-outs and be ready to take a first pass with your legal.
4) Pen test options — provide either (a) latest third-party pen test report, or (b) scoped architecture and a Redwood contact for a joint review session if you prefer a live Q/A.

Action owners and timing (tentative):
- Redwood (Dylan): deliver SOC 2 report and control mapping by EOD Fri (2026-01-16).
- Redwood (Monica): prepare audit-log sample and minimal export instructions by Mon (2026-01-19).
- Redwood (Marcus): upload DPA redline to DocuSign link and confirm if additional legal info is needed by Tue (2026-01-20).
- FirstBank (Alice + security@firstbank.com): confirm whether a redacted pen-test report is sufficient or if you want an architecture review by Mon (2026-01-19).

Attachments I will send this thread: SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (control mapping), audit-log-sample.txt (anonymized export).

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync next week to walk the control mapping and confirm acceptance criteria for the audit-log export. If that works, I can send a calendar invite for Wed 1/21 10am PT.

Thanks again — aim is to make the security review as low-friction as possible.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: We will need the full Type II report if available; if you only have a bridge letter, please include that but mark which controls map to logging/retention.
- Audit logs: retention policy is 7 years; format preference is CSV or JSON Lines with checksums. We will want to validate a sample (anonymized) to confirm schema and checksum approach.
- DPA: procurement will push for contract language on deletion timelines and notification of new subprocessors. We typically prefer to see a redline in Word/PDF.
- Pen test: security@firstbank.com would prefer the latest third-party pen test report first. If that's not publicly shareable, we can consider a live architecture review.

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide an attestation on key management (who has access to KMS keys and whether they are customer-managed)? If not customer-managed, we will need to know the access controls and rotation cadence.

If you can get the SOC 2 packet & sample logs by 1/16 and DPA redline by 1/20, procurement can start their review. We are generally available for the 1/21 slot.

Regards,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Analyst — Third-Party Risk
